author: J. Pitman and M. Yor
title: A guide to Brownian motion and related stochastic processes
inspected: Primary author exposition, printed page 40 equation (74), Trotter occupation-density context; printed page 41 equation (79), reflected Brownian occupation density. No new joint continuity theorem imported.
